name: Piknik s Samantoj
source:
Just you, Samantha, and a beautiful summer day...

Semyon and Samantha are heading into the forest for a picnic. An eventful day awaits them, filled with surprises and heart-to-heart conversations. Immerse yourself in the summer atmosphere and watch their relationship unfold.
